hook.name: MoonCatsStrategyHookV2
hook.description: Collects configurable buy/sell fees (up to 10%, 60% for the first 90 minutes post-launch) via afterSwapReturnsDelta; converts non-ETH fees to ETH via a nested pool swap, then distributes proceeds to a strategy contract (80%), marketing wallet (10%), and secondary wallet (10%). Restricts pool initialization and liquidity addition to the associated strategy contract.
